summary: Parkevtate Vosianc's September 22 video reassesses McDonald's after a disappointing 2026 — the stock is down over 18%, and he admits his call ranking it a top-10 stock to buy for 2026 was early. Management pushed the 50,000-store target from 2027 to 2028 amid executional difficulties and macro headwinds: less disposable income means fewer eat-out visits, while rising minimum wages, tariffs (raising food and build-out costs) and the Iran war/oil prices squeeze both operations and consumers. Despite this, the business remains highly lucrative: $27.7B trailing-12-month revenue with operating margins still above 45%. His original bullishness rested on technology tailwinds — in-store kiosks, AI at drive-thrus, and expanding food-delivery networks reducing labor dependence — but those benefits were delayed and overshadowed by the headwinds. On valuation, McDonald's trades at a forward P/E of 17.8, down from 24 earlier in 2026 and the cheapest in a very long time. He revised his DCF lower, pushing innovation benefits out to 2029, and now sees ~18% upside over 12-18 months vs a $250 market price (the exact fair-value figure is garbled in the auto-captions). He expects 2026 to remain difficult with headwinds persisting, but judges the risk/reward attractive given McDonald's low-risk profile, keeping it ranked among the best stocks to buy right now — effectively a 'right business, early timing' reiteration. Calls per supplied list: MCD BUY @ $250.
title: Is McDonald's an Undervalued Dividend Stock to Buy Right Now?
